title: Coaching pulse - prep + actions (CS <> SE sync)
content:
Meeting: coaching pulse (CS <> SE) - prep scratchpad
Date: 2026-03-14 10:00 PT
Attendees: Ivy Chen (CS), Diego Morales (SE), optional: Sofia for escalation sizing
Duration: 30m
Context / Why: weekly calibration for high-touch accounts; focus this week on stretch renewal at-risk accounts + one escalated SLO issue; want alignment on next outreach, technical asks, and possible playbook tweaks.

Top objectives for this sync:
- Align on language for outreach to LumenSys (renewal in 8wks) — technical ask list and exec engagement trigger.
- Decide whether to surface mitigation TCs to product for SLO patch (risk threshold: >3% 95p latency regressions).
- Review Diego's brief on embedding throughput option for Brightwave POC and finalize action owner for probe.

Quick status snapshots (notes-to-self style):
- LumenSys: renewal checkpoint 2026-05-10; CSM health score 58 (usage drop last 4 wks). Main pain: latency spikes on long sequences; SE diagnosed KV cache behavior under heavy prefix reuse. Customer-runner: Aaron (engineering), Exec: Maria Lopez (CTO).
- Brightwave: POC running on dedicated dev pool; embedding QPS requirement bumped to 150/s, currently 110/s with 8GB cache. SE suggested quantization profile + small batching change.
- AtlasRetail: low risk, but flagged for proactive feature rollout (observability hooks) — defer this week.

Talking points / Script ideas:
- "We see pattern of latency with longer-context flows; Diego can share a quick diagnostic and two mitigations: (1) bump KV cache allocation for the hot path, (2) temporary routing to a slightly older model variant while we investigate. Which would you prefer we trial?"
- For exec outreach: short one-pager with concrete SLO numbers and mitigation timeline; ask Maria for 30-min war room next Wed if we can't get below 2% p95 regressions by EOW.

Technical notes (to share quickly in meeting):
- Diego: bring the small diag (latency distribution by request length) + the patch-level risk assessment for increasing cache shards.
- Proposed quick experiment: enable sticky routing for LumenSys to region-a (lower tail latency historically) for 72 hours, measure p95 and error delta.

Decisions to make (aim for in this meeting):
- Agree to immediate sticky routing (Yes / No)
- Approve SE probe (Diego) to raise cache allocation by 25% for 48h (Yes / No)
- Trigger exec intro if mitigation fails (Yes / No)

Action items (post-meeting template):
- Diego: produce diagnostic slide (latency by length, top failure traces) + run cache-allocation probe. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Ivy: draft exec one-pager and send to Maria (CC Diego). Due: 2026-03-17.
- Diego + Ivy: prepare war-room agenda if probe fails (owner: Ivy). Due: 2026-03-19.
- Sofia: if we decide to escalate SLO issue to product, create ticket with prioritization rationale (owner: Sofia). Due: 2026-03-18.

Follow-up cadence / expectations:
- Quick async update in Slack once probe starts + 24h interim status.
- If p95 regressions improve by >=1.5% within 48h, notify customer and propose gradual rollback of sticky routing.

Notes to self (raw, keep short):
- Be explicit with customer about rollback plan — they worry about perf variability.
- Avoid technical jargon in exec one-pager; center on business impact (cart conversion delta / revenue exposure).
- If Maria asks about dedicated capacity costs, have ballpark: +$6k/mo for the reserved pool we recommended (estimate).

Risks / unknowns to raise quickly:
- Probe could increase cost temporarily if cache shards bumped — need quick approval route from finance if >$2k delta/week.
- Potential migration to older model variant may impact quality; include fallback test set to validate.

Open questions (to resolve in meeting):
- Does Diego need additional infra quota to run the 48h probe? (quick check with infra slack: #infra-quotas)
- Is account exec intro OK with CS leadership if probe shows no improvement? (confirm escalation matrix)

Playbook references / links (callouts):
- Renewal playbook: confluence://redwood/CS/renewal-playbook (use sections: quick-probes, exec-escalation)
- SLO escalation: confluence://redwood/ops/slo-escalation

One-liner closing ask (for meeting end):
- "Agree the probe + communication plan so I can send the exec one-pager by EOD and kick off the 48h probe overnight."

Post-meeting quick checklist (for Ivy):
- Capture decisions in account doc and update health score (done)
- Send exec one-pager draft to Maria (done)
- Create follow-up Jira for product if Sofia greenlights (attach diag)

Misc scratch items (later):
- Draft template for sticky-routing customer notice (short subject line suggestions)
- Add a short sample sentence for exec email: "We propose a short mitigation that we expect to reduce p95 latency by ~1-3% within 48 hours; we will follow-up with full technical analysis."

Final note: keep meeting tight — focus decisions, not diagnostics. Save deeper root-cause for post-probe write-up.

-- Ivy (working notes)
